description: This Java class 'SensorLiveGraph' is a Swing component for real-time visualization of sensor data within the rusefi project. It manages sensor data fetching, graph rendering, user interaction for setting parameters like scale and refresh rate, and maintains internal state related to sensor configuration.

classes.name: SensorLiveGraph
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that displays a real-time graph of sensor data, with user controls for sensor selection, refresh rate, and scale settings.

methods.name: SensorLiveGraph
methods.description: Constructor initializing the graph with configuration, default sensor, and UI options.

methods.name: createRunnable
methods.description: Creates a background thread runnable that periodically fetches sensor data.

methods.name: grabNewValue
methods.description: Fetches the latest sensor value and updates the graph.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays context menu with sensor, scale, and refresh rate options.

methods.name: addChangePeriodItems
methods.description: Adds menu items to change the refresh period.

methods.name: addChangeSensorItems
methods.description: Adds menu items for sensor selection by category and sensor.

methods.name: setSensor
methods.description: Sets the current sensor and resets data values.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new sensor value to the data buffer.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides Swing paint method to render the sensor data graph and labels.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Calculates visible value range based on scale settings.

methods.name: paintLastValue
methods.description: Draws the most recent sensor value on the graph.

methods.name: paintGraph
methods.description: Draws the sensor data points and connection lines.
